question: Does a liquidity rule fixed in advance predict which symbols the deployed strategy works on?
strategy: bot default: 4B + V2 stop-width + BTC Kumo gate B, DONCHIAN10 4h, risk 0.75%, initial stop 2.0 ATR, 2 bps, 2021-10-05..2026-10-05
liquidity_measure: trailing quote volume = sum(volume*close) over the last 180 CLOSED 4h bars (30 days) at each signal bar; fewer than 180 bars of history => not eligible. Rank among the universe at that bar (point-in-time, no hindsight list).

T1_primary_clean.universe: U20 = NEW10 + HOLD10 (never used for tuning)
T1_primary_clean.null: 200 random static 10-symbol subsets of U20 (seed 20261007), same engine
pass_if_all: TOP10 beats BOT10 in >= 2 of 3 sub-periods H1/H2/Y2026
Calmar(TOP10) >= 90th percentile of the random-subset null

T2_per_symbol.universe: all 25 symbols, each run alone with 1 slot, BTC gate applied (BTC itself ungated)
T2_per_symbol.test: Spearman correlation between full-period Calmar and the symbol's average point-in-time liquidity rank among 25 (rank 1 = most liquid); reported also on the 20 untouched symbols only
T2_per_symbol.pass_if: on U20: rho < 0 (more liquid = better) with one-sided permutation p < 0.05 (10000 permutations)

T3_descriptive_only: ALL25 with dynamic TOP5 / TOP8 / TOP10 by liquidity, 4 slots. Contaminated by OLD5 tuning; not a pass/fail test.
sensitivity_not_decisive: liquidity window 90 days (540 bars) for T1
caveat: All 25 symbols are ones still listed today (survivorship); delisted coins are absent, which flatters every arm equally but not the bottom tail.
